closed_loop_50.verification: Read this small control JSON on the compute node; assert exactly 50 task rows, 50 unique episode_idx values, and exact equality with episode_ids above. Do not read any other old result/freeze artifact.

prior_valid_prefix.source: run_lewm_recurrent_student.py context-manifest episode selector, reconstructed from the HDF5 ep_len vector.
prior_valid_prefix.exclusion_unit: Build episode IDs [i for i, ep_len in enumerate(ep_len_column) if ep_len >= 26], shuffle with random.Random(20300903), and exclude the first 600 IDs.

candidate_selection.episode_pool: Episode IDs with ep_len >= 26 after removing the frozen closed-loop-50 IDs and reconstructed valid-prefix-600 IDs.
candidate_selection.row_rule: Shuffle sorted eligible episode IDs with the frozen RNG and take the first 32. For each selected episode, choose start_step uniformly from [0, ep_len - 26], then set row_index = ep_offset + start_step and verify episode_idx[row_index] and step_idx[row_index] by scalar metadata reads.
candidate_selection.partition_rule: First 16 selected episodes are collection; remaining 16 are reserved_holdout.
candidate_selection.holdout_use: Selection metadata only. The shadow diagnostic may access collection episodes only; reserved_holdout episodes remain untouched for a separately frozen future confirmation.

shadow_diagnostic_freeze.t25_definition: Rollout step 25: after exactly 25 actual environment transitions from the selected t0 state, following the official evaluator's unmodified student-only action-commit semantics; if an episode terminates earlier, record t25 as unavailable without replacement.
shadow_diagnostic_freeze.episode_metric: student standardized teacher-cost regret at rollout step 25 minus t0, on the naturally continued on-policy CEM distributions; interpret as combined simulator-state, history, and candidate-distribution drift, not a pure state effect
shadow_diagnostic_freeze.solver_rng: Initialize each episode with native solver seed 42 and preserve generator continuation from t0 through rollout step 25; never reseed at t25.
shadow_diagnostic_freeze.shadow_only: Teacher labels are computed after each snapshot and never affect actions or simulator transitions. A shadow-on versus shadow-off replay of the same collection task starts from the same simulator state and native solver seed 42; compare each solve's active task, pre-solve RNG state, candidate shape, selected action, and simulator state through t25 to verify shadow non-interference.
shadow_diagnostic_freeze.diagnostic_go_rule: At least 12 of 16 collection episodes have both t0 and t25; median episode-level regret increase is at least +0.05; and at least ceil(0.75 * matched_episode_count) episodes have a strictly positive increase. Otherwise stop without training.
shadow_diagnostic_freeze.nested_samples_are_not_replicates: Candidates, CEM rounds, and snapshots are aggregated within source episode; they do not increase the independent sample count.

execution_limits.resource: 1 CPU node, 4 CPUs, 16 GB RAM, no GPU
